data.description:
• Updated for SPT 4.0.11 compatibility
  • Fixed Singleton/GameWorld API changes
  • Fixed day/night detection for Cultists
  • Code refactored and cleaned up

What’s New

✨ 3D Boss Markers

  • Real-time floating markers above boss heads
  • Customizable symbol: ▼ ▽ ↓ ● ◆ ★ ⚠ ☠ ◉ ▲
  • Show/hide boss name and distance
  • Full RGB color customization
  • Press P to toggle markers on/off

👁️ Line of Sight Option

  • New “Show Through Walls” setting
  • When OFF, markers only appear with direct vision

🐛 Bug Fixes

  • Fixed Intel Center API for SPT 4.0.11

⚠️ HOTFIX

Fixed crash for non-Fika users.

🐛 Fixed

  • Removed Fika code that was causing SPT to fail loading for users without Fika installed
  • Goons markers: Big Pipe and Birdeye now display 3D markers correctly (previously only Knight had a marker)
  • Dead boss notification: Pressing O after killing a boss now shows “eliminated ☠” instead of “located”

✨ New

  • Fika Sync Addon: Multiplayer support is now available as a separate addon! Download here
    • Syncs boss locations from host to all clients
    • Syncs boss death status to all players
    • Both host and clients need the addon installed

📋 Requirements

  • SPT 4.0.x
  • Fika 2.1.0+ (only if using the Fika Sync Addon)

⚠️ SPT 4.1.3 COMPATIBILITY FIX

✨ New

  • Added support for custom boss groups (RUAF, UNTAR, Black Division) — auto-detected when the corresponding mod is installed, with their own notifications, 3D markers, and configurable marker color/character

🐛 Fixed

  • Fixed the mod failing to work at all on current SPT — NotificationManagerClass was renamed to NotificationManager in the SPT 4.1.3 client, which broke all boss notifications

📋 Requirements

  • SPT 4.1.3
